project_members_base.name: project_members_base
project_members_base.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.member_short_name AS member_short_name,
  -- lift normalization literal out: use lower() and regexp_replace to remove non-word chars and collapse spaces
  lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(pm.member_name, ''), '[^\\w\\s]+', '', 'g')) AS member_name_normalized,
  pm.unics_id AS pm_unics_id
FROM
  project_members pm
project_members_base.description: Row-level cohort of project members with primary member and location identifiers and role; one row per project_members record.

projects_core.name: projects_core
projects_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year
FROM projects p
projects_core.description: Basic project identifiers and metadata used to link projects to related entities (acronym, unics_id, title, start/end years).

project_member_with_project.name: project_member_with_project
project_member_with_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.project AS project,
  p.unics_id AS projects_unics_id,
  p.acronym AS projects_acronym
FROM project_members_base pm
LEFT JOIN projects_core p
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id::text::integer
project_member_with_project.description: Denormalized view joining projects to their members to provide member details for each project; one row per project_members record (member) enriched with project acronym and project identifiers.
